answer: Each agent must consult an atlas of routes: the beacon emits a sparrow signal each epoch, and the agent must chart a unique delta path. The first mapping costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent waypoint doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at waypoint 14 (20.4 M iterations). A delta audit verifies each route against the epoch signal; any wrong turn voids the journey. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full atlas cost because each path binds to the unique identity key—no shared route possible.
